Class SyncDataSource.ConstValueFilter<T,F>

java.lang.Object
org.quark.synq.SyncDataSource.ConstValueFilter<T,F>
Type Parameters:
T - The type of the entity to filter
F - The type of the field value to test with
All Implemented Interfaces:
SyncDataSource.SyncDataFilter<T>
Enclosing interface:
SyncDataSource<U,T>
public static class SyncDataSource.ConstValueFilter<T,F> extends Object implements SyncDataSource.SyncDataFilter<T>
A simple SyncDataSource.SyncDataFilter implementation that tests the value of an entity's field against a constant value.
